2608.22622.title: Teaching LLMs How ICU Physicians Approach Clinical Reasoning Through OMOP-Aligned Retrieval Improves Reasoning Across Clinical Domains
2608.22622.paper_summary: Clinical decision-making relies on identifying relevant patient information to guide diagnosis and treatment, a challenge that is especially difficult in the data-dense and rapidly changing intensive care unit (ICU). Large language models (LLMs) could support this task. However, existing applications and datasets mostly emphasize surface-level retrieval or factual recall rather than the inductive and deductive reasoning clinicians practice to select and reason over decision-relevant evidence. We hypothesized that training LLMs on expert ICU reasoning could yield clinical reasoning skills that generalize beyond critical care. Here we introduce ICU-REACT, a reasoning dataset developed with 19 clinicians through a clinician-in-the-loop framework to teach LLMs to perform information retrieval and context-aware clinical reasoning in the ICU. Using ICU-REACT, we fine-tuned Clin-REACT models spanning 8B-70B parameters and three model families. Across five clinical reasoning benchmarks, Clin-REACT consistently outperformed its backbone models and open-source general-purpose and medical LLMs. Gains extended to different tasks including script concordance tests, and downstream diagnosis and treatment tasks. These findings suggest that expert reasoning supervision in critical care can improve broader clinical reasoning, although prospective evaluation is needed before real-world clinical use.
2608.22622.paper_summary_zh: 臨床決策依賴於識別相關的病人信息以指導診斷和治療，這在數據密集且快速變化的重症監護病房（ICU）中特別具有挑戰性。大型語言模型（LLMs）可以支持這項任務。然而，現有的應用程序和數據集大多強調表面層次的檢索或事實回憶，而不是臨床醫生在選擇和推理決策相關證據時所進行的歸納和演繹推理。我們假設在專家ICU推理上訓練LLMs可以產生超越重症護理的臨床推理技能。在這裡，我們介紹ICU-REACT，這是一個通過臨床醫生參與的框架與19位臨床醫生共同開發的推理數據集，旨在教導LLMs在ICU中執行信息檢索和上下文感知的臨床推理。使用ICU-REACT，我們微調了涵蓋8B-70B參數和三個模型系列的Clin-REACT模型。在五個臨床推理基準測試中，Clin-REACT始終超越其基礎模型以及開源的通用和醫療LLMs。這些增益擴展到不同的任務，包括腳本一致性測試，以及下游的診斷和治療任務。這些發現表明，在重症護理中專家的推理監督可以改善更廣泛的臨床推理，儘管在實際臨床使用之前需要進行前瞻性評估。
